fields.finding: Per-member peaks are applied over whole members; a second envelope applies the global maximum everywhere. Complete-member common-scale and coupon-volume calibrations are separate hypotheses and give very different probabilities.
fields.remaining: Calibrate the actual stress-field and size transfer. A common complete-member scale despite unequal lengths must not be silently reinterpreted as a volume-calibrated material constant. Zero positive longitudinal stress does not close multiaxial tension risk.
